headline: Increasing SE swell from low pressure. Winds improve and really fun surf chest+ high develops.
body:
Dawn to Midday: Low pressure shifting up the East Coast sets up increasing SE swell. Pretty good consensus that winds will swing offshore W/WNW behind a front too. So, this is shaping up to be a really fun day of surf. Currently expecting waves to build into the chest high or better range by midday.
Afternoon Outlook: More really fun surf with continued offshore winds. Surf is easily chest high with potential for larger head high sets at standouts.

headline: Increasing S/SE swell from low pressure. Winds improve with firing overhead surf.
body:
Dawn to Midday: Low pressure shifting up the East Coast sets up increasing S/SE swell. Winds will swing offshore NW to W behind a front too. So, this is shaping up to be a really fun day of surf. Currently expecting waves to building into the overhead high range. E facers will be cleanest. Lots of waves pouring in.
Afternoon Outlook: More fun/solid surf with continued offshore W winds and clean conditions at E facers.

headline: Firing head to overhead high surf. Strong SE swell from low pressure with developing W/WNW winds.
body:
Dawn to Midday: Low pressure shifting up the East Coast sets up a solid round of SE swell. Looking for head-overhead high surf. Winds go more W/WNW offshore through the morning. So, the outlook has improved for clean conditions locally. Lots of waves and pretty peaky with the mid period swell, so the surf is really pretty darn good.
Afternoon Outlook: Winds remain mostly offshore and the surf eases only slowly. Still plenty of head high groomed surf.
